questions.stem: A 22-year-old female presents to the clinic with complaints of intermittent chest pain and exertional dyspnea. On examination, a brachio-femoral pulse delay is noted. This patient is a known case of 45 XO syndrome and also exhibits signs of cyanosis in her toes but has pink fingers. Which of the following statements is true regarding the auscultatory findings in this patient?

options.label: B
options.text: The murmur is heard predominantly in diastole

options.label: C
options.text: The murmur is continuous and peaks at S2

options.label: D
options.text: The murmur is loudest at the apex of the heart
